cases.input: Hi, I noticed two charges of $29.99 on my card this week for what should be one monthly subscription. Can you look into this and refund the extra charge?
cases.expected_summary: Customer was double-charged and wants the duplicate refunded.
cases.notes: Clear billing case with an explicit ask.

cases.input: Every time I try to export my report to PDF the app just freezes and I have to force-close it. This has happened four times today.
cases.expected_summary: App freezes when exporting a report to PDF.

cases.input: I changed my email address last week and now I can't log in with either my old or new email. Please help me regain access.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out after changing their email address.

cases.input: Do you offer student discounts? I'm currently enrolled full-time and would love to know if there's a special rate.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking whether student discounts are available.
cases.notes: Pre-sales question, no account or billing issue yet.

cases.input: I upgraded to the Pro plan yesterday but I still don't see the Pro features unlocked in my dashboard, and I was also charged the old price instead of the new discounted rate.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged the wrong price and Pro features aren't unlocked after upgrading.
cases.notes: Straddles billing and technical/account; billing is primary because pricing is the core complaint. Could reasonably be tagged technical too.

cases.input: my account got suspended right after I disputed a charge with my bank, is that related?
cases.expected_summary: Customer's account was suspended shortly after disputing a charge and wants to know if the two are connected.
cases.notes: Account suspension is the actionable issue even though billing dispute is the trigger.

cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about a refund.
cases.notes: Extremely short, no context. Tests graceful handling of minimal input.

cases.input: hii i cant loginn to my acount its saying wrng password evrn tho im sure its rite
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in and believes their password is being incorrectly rejected.
cases.notes: Heavy typos, tests robustness of understanding.

cases.input: Hola, mi factura de este mes tiene un cargo que no reconozco, can you please check my billing history?
cases.expected_summary: Customer does not recognize a charge on their bill and wants it reviewed.

cases.input: Oh great, ANOTHER outage. Third one this week. Really loving the 'reliability' you all keep advertising. Any chance this gets fixed before next year?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is frustrated about repeated service outages and wants them fixed.
cases.notes: Sarcasm could confuse sentiment-sensitive models into misreading intent.

cases.expected_summary: Email content is unintelligible; no clear request could be identified.
cases.notes: Garbage input, tests fallback behavior rather than forced classification.

cases.input: Three things: 1) I was overcharged $10 last invoice, 2) the mobile app keeps logging me out every hour, and 3) can you add dark mode as a feature request?
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports an overcharge, frequent app logouts, and requests a dark mode feature.
cases.notes: Multi-issue email; billing chosen as primary since it's listed first and has a concrete financial impact. Tests single-label forcing on multi-topic input.
